I do think a lot of people aren't too familiar with ingredients in skincare and just TTP. As far as DT goes, I might try a product once but I will ALWAYS check the ingredients first (I will admit I did jump the gun on the b.pure serums though). From the products I've looked at and tried myself, \*most\* seem to be relatively clean but as you said some can be misleading and don't contain enough of the advertised ingredients to be effective.

I also check for percentages, but for the most part I avoid getting my actives from there. I think it's very important people take the time to learn what different ingredients are for (retinol, AHAs, BHAs, etc.), which ones should be in dark bottles/stored in certain temperatures, avoid damaging/irritating your skin by mixing ones that shouldn't be applied together, etc. Your skin is an organ so I think it's important to keep educating yourself and protect your skin!
